title: sequenceDerivedCoherence
statement:
Use the coefficient sequence module categories, chosen geometric and scalar comparisons, and bracketing interpretation of [def-trf-quotient-system-coherence-data]. The following component equation holds for the stipulated whole-system derived functors, with exactly the coefficient-field, scheme and invertibility hypotheses displayed in the Lean signature below. No boundedness, normalization, Tor-amplitude or coefficient-flatness assumption is added.

Lean statement:
theorem sequenceDerivedCoherence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {Y Z W V : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V)
    (S : coefficientSequenceDerived l E V) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E)
      (Category.assoc j h k))).app S ≫
      (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E j (h ≫ k)).hom.app S ≫
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E j).map
        ((integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h k).hom.app S) =
      (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E (j ≫ h) k).hom.app S ≫
      (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E j h).hom.app
        ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E k).obj S)
